title: A+E Global Media’s Dan Silberman Joins AI Company Sol as Its New Head of Marketing and Communications
description: A+E Global Media exec VP of communications Dan Silberman is exiting after 20 years (and more than 25 years in the TV world) to take on a new role i
body:
A+E Global Media exec VP of communications Dan Silberman is exiting after 20 years (and more than 25 years in the TV world) to take on a new role in the AI space. Silberman has joined Sol, which works with businesses in implementing AI workflow, as its new head of marketing and communications.

	Silberman will report to Sol managing partner Kaan Aslansan and will continue to be based in New York. At Sol, Silberman will handle brand, marketing and communications strategy, including “positioning and narrative, earned media, content and thought leadership, digital presence, internal communications and reputation management.”
	

	“We’ve built Sol on the strength of our delivery. Now we’re investing in making sure the market knows it,” said Aslansan in a statement. “Dan has built and defended brands under genuine public scrutiny, at a scale most firms never touch. He’s exactly what this next phase of growth needs, and he’ll make sure the market sees what our clients already do.”

	At A+E Global Media, Silberman oversaw media relations, corporate and internal communications, crisis management, social strategy and talent relations for A&E Network, History Channel, A+E Factual Studios, A&E Indie Films and more. He began his career at New York’s Rubenstein Communications, then later joined Bravo Media, where he helped its transformation into a pop culture destination with early hits like “Queer Eye for the Straight Guy” and “Project Runway.”

	“Twenty-five years in television taught me that attention follows the story you tell about your work, not just the work itself,” said Silberman. “Sol is competing with firms several times its size and winning, which is the rare case where the story is sitting right there waiting to be told. I’m joining a team of doers that is reshaping how their clients operate, and I’m here to make sure it sounds like it. I’ve made a career of learning a new business from the best people in it. I want Sol to be the name people already know when we walk in the room.”
	

	Sol’s “agentic AI systems, workflow modernization and workforce transformation” focuses on fields including media, entertainment and adtech, as well as state and local government and education.

schema.headline: A+E Global Media’s Dan Silberman Joins AI Company Sol as Its New Head of Marketing and Communications

title: John Carpenter to Receive Filmmaker of the Year at ACE Eddie Awards
description: Filmmaker, screenwriter, producer and composer John Carpenter will receive the American Cinema Editors (ACE) Golden Eddie Filmmaker of the Year awa
body:
Filmmaker, screenwriter, producer and composer John Carpenter will receive the American Cinema Editors (ACE) Golden Eddie Filmmaker of the Year award at the 77th annual ACE Eddie Awards.

	Editors Bonnie Koehler and Christopher Nelson will also receive ACE Career Achievement awards during the ceremony, which recognizes the best film editing achievements of the year across film and television. Comedian and actor Patton Oswalt is set to return to host the awards, held on Feb. 6.
	

	Carpenter was largely introduced to audiences in 1978 with “Halloween” and has since gone on to shape the modern horror genre with directing credits that include “The Fog,” “The Thing,” “Vampires,” “Escape from New York” and “They Live.” He composed “Lost Themes” in 2014, as well as “Cathedral” earlier this year.

	“John Carpenter makes movies that get under your skin and stay there,” said Sabrina Plisco, the president of ACE. “’Halloween,’ ‘The Thing,’ ‘Escape from New York’ — these films have scared, thrilled and shaped generations of audiences and filmmakers alike. Few directors understand rhythm, tension and restraint the way he does, and he has always trusted his editors to help him find it. That collaboration is exactly what this honor celebrates.”

	Carpenter joins the ranks of former winners that include Jon M. Chu, John Waters, Spike Lee, Quentin Tarantino, Christopher Nolan, Lauren Shuler Donner, Guillermo del Toro, Steven Spielberg, Vince Gilligan, J.J. Abrams, Nancy Meyers, Martin Scorsese, George Lucas and the Sundance Institute.

	Throughout her more than 40-year career, Koehler edited 15 feature films, nine primetime television series and eight movies-of-the-week. Her credits include “One Flew Over the Cuckoo’s Nest, “The Empire Strikes Back,” “Return of the Jedi,” “Poltergeist,” “Law & Order: Special Victims Unit” and “L.A. Law.”
	

	Nelson has worked as a producer, director and film editor, working on more than 70 television series, movies and pilots. He received a Primetime Emmy for best editing for the series finale of “Lost,” as well as additional Emmy nominations for “Lost,” “Six Feet Under,” “China Beach,” “Mad Men” and the pilot of “The Greatest American Hero.” Recent credits include “Bates Motel,” “Waco” and “Godfather of Harlem.”

	“Bonnie Koehler and Chris Nelson are editors other editors look up to,” Plisco added. “Bonnie went from ‘American Zoetrope’ to an Emmy nomination for ‘L.A. Law’ and an ACE Eddie nomination for ‘Law & Order: Special Victims Unit,’ television’s longest-running primetime drama. Chris cut the finale of ‘Lost,’ one of the most watched and debated hours in television history, and his work on ‘Six Feet Under’ and ‘Mad Men’ helped define prestige television. Both have given generously to our community.”

	Nominations for the 77th Annual ACE Eddie Awards will be announced on Jan. 14.

schema.headline: John Carpenter to Receive Filmmaker of the Year at ACE Eddie Awards

title: Jamie Dornan Says There’s ‘Pressure’ to Taking Over Aragorn Role in ‘Lord of the Rings: Hunt for Gollum’: I’m Not ‘Trying to Outdo’ Viggo Mortensen
description: Jamie Dornan is stepping into the shoes of Aragorn in “The Lord of the Rings: The Hunt for Gollum,” after the hero was famously played by Viggo Mor
body:
Jamie Dornan is stepping into the shoes of Aragorn in “The Lord of the Rings: The Hunt for Gollum,” after the hero was famously played by Viggo Mortensen in the original “LOTR” trilogy. Dornan spoke to L’Officiel (translated by Slash Film) about taking on the role and playing a younger version in the prequel.

	“There’s pressure when you’re trying to follow in those footsteps. I’ve been asked to play a super iconic role, and I’ll do my best. But for me, Aragorn will always be just Viggo. His performance is one of my all-time favorites, and I feel honored to try to recapture at least some of the energy he originally brought to the character. There’s no part of me that’s trying to outdo him,” Dornan said.
	

	“The Hunt for Gollum” is directed by and stars Andy Serkis, who provided the voice and motion capture for the CGI hobbit in the original trilogy. Serkis, who has also helmed “Mowgli: Legend of the Jungle,” “Venom: Let There Be Carnage” and more, was the second unit director on Peter Jackson’s “The Hobbit” trilogy. “The Hunt for Gollum,” a standalone film, will be his first time as the main director on one of the fantasy franchise’s entries.

	In addition to Serkis returning to Middle-Earth, “The Hunt for Gollum” brings back Ian McKellen as Gandalf and Elijah Wood as Frodo. Newcomers include Kate Winslet, Leo Woodall, Lee Pace and Anya Taylor-Joy. The new film will be told from Gollum’s perspective as Gandalf sends a young Aragorn out to find the corrupted hobbit. Before coming rising to fame as Aragorn, heir to the throne of Gondor, the hero is a lonely hunter known as Strider in “The Hunt for Gollum.”

schema.headline: Jamie Dornan Says There’s ‘Pressure’ to Taking Over Aragorn Role in ‘Lord of the Rings: Hunt for Gollum’: I’m Not ‘Trying to Outdo’ Viggo Mortensen

title: Fox News Ratings Sink a Staggering 27% in October, but It Still Has Much a Larger Audience Than CNN or MS NOW
description: In the lead-up to the 2026 midterm elections, Fox News lost more than a quarter of its overall viewing audience in the month of October, according
body:
In the lead-up to the 2026 midterm elections, Fox News lost more than a quarter of its overall viewing audience in the month of October, according to new data. That said, the network remains the most-watched news outlet on cable, well ahead of rivals CNN and MS NOW.

	For October 2026, Fox News is on track to post its lowest-rated month in total-day viewers since December 2023, according to preliminary figures from Nielsen, first reported by Status. FNC averaged 1.1 million total viewers for the month, down 27%, and 98,000 viewers in the key 25-54 demographic coveted by advertisers, a drop of 32%.
	

	The ratings decline comes amid a continuation of the drop-off in TV viewers overall — but Fox News has been losing viewers at a double-digit clip as CNN and MS NOW have been slightly up in recent months. As Variety has reported, Fox News on many nights draws a bigger live audience than one or more broadcast TV networks. But its viewership is steadily eroding: In the third quarter of 2026, Fox News saw total-day viewership decline 16%, and viewership in the 25-54 demo fall 24%. Both CNN and MS NOW saw small gains in overall audience for Q3.

	In primetime, Fox News averaged about 2 million total viewers (down 28% year over year) in October, with viewers in the 25-54 demo falling 36% to 183,000, according to the Nielsen data. “Fox & Friends” had its second consecutive month below 1 million total viewers and under 100,000 in the key demo, with October representing its lowest overall viewers since July 2015 (and its lowest in the 25-54 demographic since June 2001).
	

	Meanwhile, progressive rival MS NOW saw its daytime audience rise 16% to 588,000 total viewers in October, and CNN viewership was up 3% to 402,000 viewers over the same timeframe, according to the preliminary Nielsen figures.

	In an email, a Fox News rep noted that on YouTube, the network has a solid lead over other news outlets. Year to date through Oct. 27, Fox News has generated 3.8 billion views on YouTube, followed by MS NOW (3.0 billion), CNN (2.4 billion), ABC News (1.4 billion), NBC News (1.2 billion) and CBS News (543,000), according to data from Emplifi.

	Some observers detect a worrisome sign in Fox News’ ratings decline that conservatives are tuning out at rates faster than CNN or MS NOW as the fight for control of the Senate and House of Representatives will be up for grabs on Election Day next week, Nov. 3.

	President Donald Trump — whose feelings about Fox News historically run hot and cold — recently complained that the network has not been backing Republicans strongly enough.

	“Fox spends more time defending Dumocrats, and putting on their views versus their Republican opponent, than at any time in the History of FoxNews,” Trump wrote in an Oct. 19 post on Truth Social. “It’s ridiculous! FoxNews is trying too hard to be Politically Correct!”

schema.headline: Fox News Ratings Sink a Staggering 27% in October, but It Still Has Much a Larger Audience Than CNN or MS NOW

title: ‘Beast in Me’ Season 2 Casts John Goodman
description:
John Goodman has joined “The Beast in Me” Season 2 at Netflix, Variety has learned. 

	The second season of the series was announced in September,
body:
John Goodman has joined “The Beast in Me” Season 2 at Netflix, Variety has learned. 

	The second season of the series was announced in September, with Season 1 star Claire Danes set to return as Aggie Wiggs. Goodman will play Jack, Aggie’s father. Exact plot details for Season 2 are currently under wraps. 

	Goodman is an 11-time Emmy nominee, including seven nods for his starring role in the hit sitcom “Roseanne.” He won the award for outstanding guest actor in a drama in 2007 for “Studio 60 on the Sunset Strip.” He recently reprised his role as Dan Conner for the revival of “Roseanne,” which was subsequently renamed “The Conners” and aired for seven more seasons. Goodman is also known for roles in shows like “The Righteous Gemstones” at HBO and “Damages” at FX. In film, Goodman has collaborated with the Coen brothers on numerous features like “Raising Arizona,” “Barton Fink,” “The Big Lebowski,” and “O Brother, Where Art Thou?” and has appeared in films like “Digger,” “Argo,” and “Flight.” 
	

	He is repped by Gersh and Frankfurt Kurnit Klein & Selz. 

	“The Beast in Me” was originally announced as a limited series when it was picked up in 2024. It also campaigned as a limited series at this year’s Emmy Awards, for which Season 1 star Matthew Rhys won the award for outstanding lead actor in a limited or anthology series. The series also won the Emmy for outstanding music composition for a limited or anthology series, movie or special (original dramatic score).

	But in the tradition of “Big Little Lies” and other “limited series” before it, Netflix and “The Beast in Me” team began exploring the possibility of a second season and opened a writers’ room earlier this year.
	

	“The Beast in Me” Season 1 showrunner Howard Gordon will serve as co-showrunner on Season 2 alongside Season 1 executive producer Daniel Pearle. Gabe Rotter is the creator and an executive producer of “The Beast in Me.” Danes will again executive produce in addition to starring. Antonio Campos, Caroline Baron, Amy Lippman, Conan O’Brien, David Kissinger, Jeff Ross, Claire Danes and Jodie Foster also executive produce. The series is produced by 20th Television.

schema.headline: ‘Beast in Me’ Season 2 Casts John Goodman

title: ‘Pride and Prejudice’ Trailer: Emma Corrin and Jack Lowden Reboot Elizabeth Bennet and Mr. Darcy’s Love Story for Netflix
description: Netflix has released the trailer for its upcoming “Pride and Prejudice” limited series, starring Emma Corrin and Jack Lowden as adversaries-to-love
body:
Netflix has released the trailer for its upcoming “Pride and Prejudice” limited series, starring Emma Corrin and Jack Lowden as adversaries-to-lovers Elizabeth Bennet and Mr. Darcy.

	The six-part series is a faithful adaptation of Jane Austen’s 1813 novel penned by “Everything I Know About Love” author Dolly Alderton, centering on the will-they-won’t-they love story of Elizabeth Bennet and Mr. Darcy as they navigate the social landscape of 19th-century England. It’s directed by “Heartstopper” helmer Euros Lyn.
	

	The cast also includes Olivia Colman (“The Crown”) as Mrs. Bennet, Rufus Sewell (“The Diplomat”) as Mr. Bennet, Freya Mavor (“Industry”) as Jane Bennet, Jamie Demetriou (“Stath Lets Flats”) as Mr. Collins, Daryl McCormack (“Wake Up Dead Man: A Knives Out Mystery”) as Mr. Bingley, Louis Partridge (“House of Guinness”) as Mr. Wickham, Rhea Norwood (“Heartstopper”) as Lydia Bennet, Siena Kelly (“Black Mirror”) as Caroline Bingley and Fiona Shaw (“Killing Eve”) as Lady Catherine de Bourg. Hopey Parish and Hollie Avery also make their debuts as Mary Bennet and Kitty Bennet.

	They will be joined by Anjana Vasan (“We Are Lady Parts”), Sebastian Armesto (“Gangs of London”), Rosie Cavaliero (“KAOS”), Saffron Coomber (“Three Little Birds and Die Zweiflers”), James Dryden (“Deadpool”), Justin Edwards (“The Thick Of It”), James Northcote (“The Last Kingdom”), Eloise Webb (“The Queen’s Gambit”) and Isabella Sermon (“Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom”).

	Executive producers include Corrin, Laura Lankester, Alderton, Lyn and Will Johnston and Louise Mutter for Lookout Point. Lisa Osborne serves as producer.
	

	“Pride and Prejudice” premieres on Netflix Dec. 3. Watch the trailer below.

schema.headline: ‘Pride and Prejudice’ Trailer: Emma Corrin and Jack Lowden Reboot Elizabeth Bennet and Mr. Darcy’s Love Story for Netflix

title: Kathleen Kennedy to Lead LA Olympics Opening and Closing Ceremonies After ‘Star Wars’ Exit, Replacing Peter Rice
description:
Kathleen Kennedy, the former head of Lucasfilm, has been tapped as head of ceremonies and content for the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics.

	She’s replac
body:
Kathleen Kennedy, the former head of Lucasfilm, has been tapped as head of ceremonies and content for the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics.

	She’s replacing Peter Rice, who was hired as Netflix’s chief content officer earlier this week and took over for Bela Bajaria. He will remain involved with the LA28 Games as executive producer, as first reported by the Hollywood Reporter.

	In her role, Kennedy will lead the delivery of all four ceremonies, including the Olympics opening on July 14, 2028, and closing on July 30 as well as the Paralympic opening on Aug. 15 and closing on Aug. 27.
	

	LA28 chairperson and president Casey Wasserman called Kennedy a “legend” and “one of Hollywood’s all-time greats.” 

	“When the stars align to focus the world’s attention on Los Angeles for the 2028 Olympic and Paralympic Games, I can’t think of anyone better to conjure the magic of Hollywood than Kathleen,” he said.

	Kennedy described the Olympics as “a touchstone in my life” and referred to the games as “one of the great unifying experiences we share.”

	“Casey Wasserman has a bold vision for what these Games can mean for Los Angeles and the world, and I’m thrilled he’s asked me to help bring it to life,” Kennedy said. “My husband, Frank Marshall, and I have attended virtually every games since Los Angeles in 1984, and sport remains one of the great unifying experiences we share. Peter Rice has laid a terrific foundation, and I can’t wait to get to work with Ben Winston, our creative director, and the whole LA28 team.”

	Kennedy left Lucasfilm at the end of 2025 after serving as president for 14 years. She maintains a relationship with the company behind “Star Wars” and “Indiana Jones,” with recent credits including last summer’s “The Mandalorian and Grogu” and the upcoming “Star Wars: Starfighter,” led by Ryan Gosling. 
	

	A widely respected producer, Kennedy worked closely with Steven Spielberg over the years on movies such as “E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial,” “Jurassic Park” and “Lincoln,” and she helped pick the director J.J. Abrams to helm 2015’s “Star Wars: The Force Awakens,” which successfully revived the franchise with more than $2 billion globally. Her tenure at Lucasfilm had both highs and lows, including misfires like 2018’s “Solo: A Star Wars Story” and 2023’s “Indiana Jones and the Dial of Destiny.”

schema.headline: Kathleen Kennedy to Lead LA Olympics Opening and Closing Ceremonies After ‘Star Wars’ Exit, Replacing Peter Rice

title: Skydance Sets Finance Leadership Team Following Paramount-Warner Bros. Merger
description:
Oct 28, 2026 9:43am PT	
	

			


			
			
	

									Courtesy of Skydance Corp.
	

		
	
				

	Skydance Corp., the new company formed
body:
Oct 28, 2026 9:43am PT	
	

			


			
			
	

									Courtesy of Skydance Corp.
	

		
	
				

	Skydance Corp., the new company formed from David Ellison’s massive Paramount-Warner Bros. Discovery merger, has established the leadership team overseeing financial operations across the business.

	Ellison and Ynon Kreiz, co-CEO of Skydance, previously announced the senior leadership team for the new company (a day before the deal officially closed). Since then, different business units and corporate groups have been laying out the new executive teams for the combined Paramount-WBD, which will have annual revenue of nearly $70 billion on a pro-forma basis and net debt of around $80 billion.
	

	On Wednesday morning, Skydance CFO Dennis Cinelli (formerly Paramount Skydance’s finance chief) sent a memo to staffers announcing the leadership team for the finance group — which will be intimately involved in trying to help the company achieve its projected $6 billion in annualized cost savings, an exercise set to include what are expected to be several rounds of layoffs. 

	“Today we’re announcing the leadership team for Skydance Finance. Each of these leaders brings the experience and judgment to help us build something exceptional, and I’m excited to work alongside them and to share where I think we can take this team from here,” Cinelli wrote in the memo, a copy of which was obtained by Variety.

	Cinelli thanked employees who “put in extraordinary effort to support the acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery” and said that “your work was essential to getting this deal done.” He also gave a shout-out to the legacy Warner Bros. Discovery finance team, writing that “you kept the business performing through a long period of not knowing how this would end. That takes discipline, and it didn’t go unnoticed.”
	

	He continued, “As you’ve heard David [Ellison] say, our goal is to become the next-generation media and entertainment company. We’ll only get there if Finance operates at the highest level and helps drive the business. Every greenlight decision, technology investment, partnership deal and number reported externally depends on the quality of your work.”

	According to Cinelli, the new Skydance financial leadership “reflects the strengths of both organizations and puts the right leaders in the right places.” Here’s the structure he outlined in the memo:

	Corporate Leaders


Kevin Creighton, EVP, Corporate Finance & Treasury, will lead an expanded organization that includes corporate finance, treasury, strategic finance, as well as the FP&A (financial planning and analysis) and Content Finance and Strategy centers of excellence. Creighton will also continue to oversee investor relations on an interim basis while Skydance searches for a new head of IR.
Fraser Woodford, EVP, Treasury at Warner Bros. Discovery, will stay through the end of March 2027 to “transition work” to Creighton’s organization and “help us find his successor.”
Todd Davis, EVP, Head of Global Tax, will lead Skydance’s global tax function, managing tax strategy, planning and compliance across all businesses and jurisdictions.
Kathy Gill-Charest, EVP, Controller & Chief Accounting Officer, will lead global controllership, including accounting, financial reporting and internal controls for all divisions.
Sandy Pundmann, EVP & Chief Audit Risk Officer, will lead internal audit and risk with a focus on strengthening controls that protect the company.
Simon Robinson, EVP & Chief Business Transformation Officer, will head up the “Integration Management Office,” coordinating integration efforts across the company “to help us combine our businesses smoothly and capture the full value of the transaction.”



	Business Unit CFOs (dual-reporting to Cinelli and their respective BU heads)


Mark Badagliacca, EVP & CFO, Film, will lead finance for the film business. He will also lead the participations and residuals center of excellence (COE) and co-lead the production finance COE.
Patrick Cavanaugh, EVP & CFO, Distribution, will lead finance for the distribution and affiliates business.
Nitin Chawla, EVP & CFO, Global Content Sales, will lead finance for content licensing and home entertainment businesses.
Adam Cohn, EVP & CFO of CNN, will lead finance for CNN news.
Eric Gray, EVP & CFO, TV Studios, will lead finance for Skydance’s Television Studio businesses, as well as co-lead the production finance COE.
Christine Hong, EVP & CFO of Advertising and Head of Revenue Operations, will lead finance for the ad business and will oversee revenue operations across the company.
Kedar Nadkarni, EVP, CFO & Head of Strategy and Insights, Consumer Products and Publishing, will lead finance across consumer products, publishing and DC comics businesses. He also will continue to lead strategy and operations under Josh Silverman, president, Skydance Products and Publishing.
Ben Paul, EVP & CFO, Games & Experiences, will lead finance for the games and experiences businesses.
Josh Walker, EVP & CFO, Streaming, will lead finance for the streaming business.
Liz Wright, EVP & CFO, Skydance TV Segment will lead finance for the global television networks business.



	In addition to those appointments, Bryon Rubin is stepping out of his role as CFO of TV Media to become COO of Skydance Television.

	“There will be challenges as we integrate businesses and keep raising the bar, but I have great confidence in this team. What we do matters, and how we do it matters even more,” Cinelli wrote in the memo.

	Cinelli also outlined six “pillars” guiding the finance organization:
	


Nail the basics: Close the books accurately and fast. Stay fully compliant on SEC reporting, tax and internal audit. Forecast with confidence and reflect the true state of the business.
Set plans: Build financial and strategic plans that align the company, drive accountability and reach ambitious long-range goals.
Partner deeply: Finance leaders sit alongside their business partners on execution and strategic trade-offs, with an owner-operator mindset. We think like we own the P&L, because we do.
Decide with data and AI: Democratize data so it moves across the company, not just within teams. Automate the grind so our time goes to analysis. Combine operating KPIs, financial KPIs and business judgment to make better investment trade-offs, sign the best deals and run efficiently.
Tell the story: Be the financial and strategic storytellers to our stakeholders and investors. Connect the numbers to the progress we’re making and the progress still ahead.
Build a talent factory: This is where top Finance talent is incubated, builds careers, and become company leaders.




	
		More from Variety

schema.headline: Skydance Sets Finance Leadership Team Following Paramount-Warner Bros. Merger

title: Variety’s 10 Actors to Watch Detail Tapping Into Dark Characters and Gaining Confidence at Newport Beach Film Festival
description: Get used to seeing these faces this awards season. Variety’s 2026 10 Actors to Watch took the stage in Newport Beach, California, for a conversatio
body:
Get used to seeing these faces this awards season. Variety’s 2026 10 Actors to Watch took the stage in Newport Beach, California, for a conversation about performance, craft and process on October 18. Variety moderated this conversation in partnership with Newport Beach Film Festival.

	The panel kicked off at the Balboa Bay Resort, highlighting this year’s selection: Jaafar Jackson (“Michael”), Inde Navarrette (“Obsession”), Ray Nicholson (“The Mosquito Bowl”), Esmé Creed-Miles (“Sense and Sensibility”), Mariana Di Girólamo (“Wild Horse Nine”), Rosalind Eleazar (“Misty Green”), Guitarricadelafuente (“La Bola Negra”), Summer H. Howell (“Carrie”), Ruth Madeley (“Being Heumann”) and Joseph Zada (“The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping”). 
	

	During the conversation, Navarrette opened up about portraying Nikki and the challenge of developing a character since there is so little of the real Nikki in “Obsession.”

	“It was really just my first opportunity where I kind of had the freedom, to a certain extent, to do whatever I could,” she said. “I really find the complication of Nikki to be what is the most beautiful about her. And I find people come up and they talk to me about her — specifically women — say, ‘That is a character that I find myself in.’ Of course people like to laugh, but I find that there’s a complexity, not just in women, but in us as people, where we are multiple people, and that’s beautiful.”



	

					Esmé Creed-Miles, Rosalind Eleazar, Mariana di Girolamo, Guitarricadelafuente, Summer Howell, Jaafar Jackson, Ruth Madeley, Inde Navarrette, Ray Nicholson, and Joseph Zada attend the Newport Beach Film Festival HONORS.
									Getty Images for Newport Beach Film Festival
	



	Jackson also spoke about the process of becoming his uncle, Michael Jackson, not just in his skills as a performer but also in his confidence.
	

	“I just wanted it to come across as I’ve done films before. I didn’t want to be seen as a first-time actor. I wanted to be able to, of course, continue to learn, but have that presence and awareness of how to walk into a room, how to get pulled in any direction because it doesn’t always go as planned or what’s on the page,” he said. “Something can happen the day of, and I was experiencing that, and I was glad I was able to prep for that and just to be in that space where Michael would do it, just to continue to be in the mind of Michael.

	Watch part one of the video above and part two below:

title: High-Speed Trains Collide In Spain Leaving at Least 30 People Dead, 80 Injured
description:
Spain Train Crash
                          At Least 30 Dead, 80 Injured After High-Speed Rail Co
body:
Spain Train Crash
                          At Least 30 Dead, 80 Injured After High-Speed Rail Collision
                      
                  
                                                                        Published 
                              October 28, 2026
                            5:24 AM PDT
                                                                      |
                                                                Updated 
                                  October 28, 2026
                                10:13 AM PDT
                                    
      
    
        
                    
                  
      
    
            A high-speed train has slammed into another train that had stopped in central Spain ... resulting in the deaths of at least 30 people.
      
    
            Castilla-La Mancha spokesperson Esther Padilla confirmed the updated casualties ... after she previously told AP News that the number of dead would "surely rise" after reporting 10 deaths initially.
      
    
                  
          
                          
                
                  
      
    
            Castilla-La Mancha President Emiliano García-Page later added that 80 people were injured in the crash ... with 50 suffering moderate to severe injuries.
      

            The collision happened Wednesday morning between the towns of Mora, Orgaz, and Urda in Spain's Toledo province.
      
    
            Padilla said both trains were high-speed rail ... and that they were both traveling from Madrid to Seville.
      
    
            While details are still being confirmed ... it appears that the Spanish-owned Renfe train -- with 397 aboard -- crashed into the privately owned Iryo train -- with 147 passengers.
      
    
                  
          
                          
                
                  
      
    
            Both train lines were also involved in a deadly crash earlier this year in January ... resulting in 45 deaths.
      
    
            Pictures from the scene show several mangled train cars derailed ... and first responders scouring the area.
      
    
            Spain's Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez has since spoken out about the tragedy on X ... "Shocked by the serious train accident in Toledo. ... Emergency services are working on the ground to assist those affected and ensure their safety, in coordination with all the involved administrations. My affection, solidarity, and support to all the victims and their families."

title: UC San Diego PhD Student Pleads Guilty to Beating 6-Week-Old Child to Death
description:
UCSD PhD Student
                          Pleads Guilty to Killing 6-Week-Old
body:
UCSD PhD Student
                          Pleads Guilty to Killing 6-Week-Old
                          ... Allegedly Admitted She Felt Compelled to Hurt Kids
                      
                  
                                                                        Published 
                              October 28, 2026
                            9:36 AM PDT
                                                                            
      
    
                  
          
                          
                
                  
      
    
            Nicole Virzi, a UC San Diego student who was just weeks away from completing her PhD when she was arrested, just pled guilty to beating a 6-week-old child to death.
      
    
            The 32-year-old PhD student pled guilty to third-degree criminal homicide for killing Leon Katz back in 2024. The maximum sentence is reportedly 40 years.
      
    
                  
          
                          
                
                  
      
    
            Leon's mother, Savannah Roberts, spoke in court after Virzi pled guilty ... saying, "[This has] eradicated my sense of safety across every domain of my life. I will never fully understand the torture and murder that Nicole inflicted on my twins."
      

            She added, "I've learned that the bogeyman is real and monsters really do live under the bed."
      
    
            Virzi and Roberts met while working as research coordinators in Drexel University's graduate psychology department in Philadelphia, PA. The two became close friends ... with Virzi even serving as Roberts' maid of honor.
      
    
            In June 2024, Virzi went to visit Roberts in Pittsburgh. According to cops, Virzi claimed she saw blood on Ari Roberts' groin. Ari is Leon's twin brother, who is still alive.
      
    
                  
          
                          
                
                  
      
    
            While Roberts and her husband went to the hospital, Virzi watched Leon ... and claimed he fell out of his baby bouncer and hit his head before she called 911. He was pronounced dead a few hours later.
      
    
            An autopsy reportedly determined the injuries were caused by blunt force trauma and were consistent with child abuse. 
      
    
            Virzi was arrested and interrogated by cops ... during which prosecutors say she admitted to killing Leon and said, "From a very, very young age, I don't know what it is, but I always had this urge - almost like a compulsion I can't control - to hurt kids."

description:
Mexico City Tesla Crash
                          Car Smashes Through Home, Goes Airborne In Wild
body:
Mexico City Tesla Crash
                          Car Smashes Through Home, Goes Airborne In Wild Video
                      
                  
                                                                        Published 
                              October 28, 2026
                            9:46 AM PDT
                                                                            
      
    
        
                    
                  
      
    
            Cameras caught the stomach-turning moment a Tesla smashed through a home in Mexico City ... before plummeting off the edge of the building and out of frame.
      
    
            The horrifying crash went down in Mexico City on October 19 ... and now the video is going viral.
      
    
                  
          
                          
                
                  
      
    
            Footage shows the intense impact as the Model Y crashes through the gate of the house and goes airborne ... flying across the terrace and smashing through the home's back wall.
      

            The car drops over the edge of the building and out of sight. International Business Times reports that the car eventually came to a stop at a lower elevation on the other side of the street.
      
    
                  
          
                          
                
                  
      
    
            Authorities haven't yet determined how the car ended up veering so far off course in the first place -- it's unclear whether it was caused by a vehicle malfunction or something else.
      
    
            The outlet reports the car has extensive damage, especially on the front end, and so far there's no word on the condition of anyone involved.

title: Man Pulls Massive Knife Out in Heated Confrontation at L.A. Wendy's on Video
description:
Wendy's
                          Guy Pulls Huge Knife During Heated Altercation
body:
Wendy's
                          Guy Pulls Huge Knife During Heated Altercation
                      
                  
                                                                        Published 
                              October 28, 2026
                            10:05 AM PDT
                                                                            
      
    
        
                    
                  
      
    
            Things got seriously scary at a Wendy's in Los Angeles ... when a man pulled a giant knife on another guy during an altercation and threatened to kill him ... and it's all on video.
      
    
            Ya gotta see the footage ... two men get in each other's faces at the Northridge fast food restaurant when one guy pulls a knife. The guy in the baseball hat dares the knife-wielding man to touch him and asks if he's going to do some stabbing. 
      
    
                  
          
                          
                
                  
      
    
            The armed man responds ... "I'll f***ing kill you, dog."
      

            From the looks of it, the whole thing started when the guy in the baseball cap came up to the man, who was sitting at a table eating with a woman.
      
    
            The guy in the cap came up to their table, seemingly antagonizing the pair when the guy got up from his seat and pulled the massive knife out from behind him.
      
    
                  
          
                          
                
                  
      
    
            The men were swearing and throwing chairs before taking the fight outside. That's when the cops pulled up and cuffed the man with the knife.
      
    
            Witness Jesus Lepit told KTLA the guy in the baseball hat was the instigator, saying ... "The customer was still talking to the employees, arguing with them."
      
    
            Lepit said the couple was "minding their own business" when the guy in the hat approached them and got in their space.
      
    
            It's unclear if the man arrested will face charges.
